_: Headshots that are PHOTOGRAPHS rather than pre-cut layers. `file` is the untouched photo and `matte` its alpha, keyed off the studio backdrop by scripts/matte.mjs so the arch's floral paper shows behind her; the app multiplies the two and then clips to the arch. `matte: null` means the crop shares another entry's photograph and its matte. `tolerance` overrides the keyer's default for one photograph - the dress is a white-on-black print close enough to the seamless that the default walks in through it - and is only ever read by the script, never by the app. `fit` is a placement saved from the Headshot Positions tool (claude.ai/artifact/SWY6VnFWkQ8fib6RAZE3UU): zoom is a multiple of the scale that covers the arch, offsets are artboard px. One source of truth - the app builds HEADSHOTS from this and build-single.mjs inlines the same paths.
